repos_data.description: Deep code indexing MCP server for AI agents. 25 tools: hybrid FTS5 + embedding search, call graphs, git blame/hotspots, build system analysis. Multi-repo workspaces, GPU-accelerated semantic search, 10 languages via tree-sitter. Fully local, zero cloud dependencies.
MCP Server for persistent code indexing. Gives AI assistants (Claude, Gemini, Copilot, Cursor) instant access to your codebase. 50x less context than grep.
Convert source code to LLM ready knowledge base
